role: Defines PipelineError (HRV analysis failure categories with log descriptions) and the attempt/sleepQuietly helpers that replace try? with a logged swallow.
types: PipelineError: enum (Error, LocalizedError) — analysis pipeline failure kinds

units.does: Returns a short English description per PipelineError case with the session UUID's first 8 chars; healthKitFetchFailed appends the underlying error's localizedDescription.
units.entry: LocalizedError witness; read via error.localizedDescription in HRVAnalysisPipeline+Metrics.swift

units.does: Runs a throwing closure, returning its value or nil; on throw logs '[operation] failed: …' at .warning attributed to the caller.

branches.effect: logs at .warning (lands in Recent Problems) and returns nil

units.contract: Runs the throwing closure and returns its value, or nil if it threw; it never rethrows. On a throw it logs '[operation] failed' at warning level attributed to the caller's file and line, so the failure lands in Recent Problems.

units.does: Awaits Task.sleep(nanoseconds:); on cancellation logs '[Sleep] interrupted during <context>' at .info and returns normally.

branches.effect: logged, swallowed; caller continues as if the sleep completed

units.contract: Sleeps for the given nanoseconds and never throws. If the task is cancelled during the sleep it logs and returns normally, so the caller continues as if the sleep had completed and must check cancellation itself if it needs to stop.
